validation_notes: Обработано 11 человек из CSV для FEES. Проверено 14 локальных PDF в папке MOEXBMI_Отчеты_2024/FEES; основной биографический источник - годовой отчет ПАО "Россети" за 2024 год, финансовая отчетность и приложения проверены и не содержат биографий. Выполнен 1 полный research round с дополнительными поисковыми проходами по людям без официальной биографии. CEO определен как Рюмин Андрей Валерьевич. Состав Правления в 2024 году подтвержден локальным годовым отчетом; председатель Совета директоров Новак А. В. подтвержден локальным отчетом. Люди без подтвержденного образования: Кулишов Григорий Викторович. Существенная неопределенность: Кулишов Г. В. (нет официальной биографии, образование и прежний опыт не найдены); Макаров В. А. (роль и образование подтверждены внешними источниками группы, но нет полной карьерной биографии и локального FEES-профиля). Слабые источники использованы только для Кулишова и частично Макарова; смысл фактов не расширялся. Однофамильцы исключались по отсутствию связки с ПАО "Россети", электросетевой отраслью, должностью и карьерной цепочкой. Научные публикации, патенты и h-index не добавлены, так как подтвержденные профили нужных лиц не найдены; ученые степени сохранены только там, где они подтверждены отчетами. Неразрешенных конфликтов не осталось; оставшиеся пробелы отражены в notes. || Round 2 (2026-07-18, gap-fill plus GICS/qualification/university-normalization pass, per REFINEMENT.md): (1) Gap-fill research, local filings first then web, targeted exactly the fields flagged as null or uncertain in round-1 notes: Kulishov G. V., empty education and degrees, professional_experience with null start_year and end_year; Murov A. E., Polinov A. A. and Kharitonov V. V., each with a named academic degree, kandidat or doktor nauk, whose institution and year were null; Makarov V. A., incomplete prior career. Local documents re-checked first: the full Rosseti_AR2024_01.07.2025.pdf, 216 pages, all 12 Prilozheniya k GO appendix PDFs and the Otchetnost MSFO PDF were re-scanned programmatically for each of these names, confirming round 1, Kulishov does not appear anywhere in this report set at all, and Murov, Polinov and Kharitonov degree-institution and year fields are genuinely not disclosed anywhere in the local filings. Web research: the session WebSearch tool budget, 200 of 200 calls, was already exhausted before this ticker round-2 pass began, so WebSearch could not be used; WebFetch was used instead on a set of targeted URLs, ar23.rosseti.ru management-board page, re-fetched for Murov, Polinov and Kharitonov, corroborates the degree titles but adds no institution or year; rossetisk.ru board page, re-fetched for Kulishov, confirms his continued absence from that board listing; guessed TAdviser and TASS person-page URLs for Kulishov, Murov, Polinov and Kharitonov all returned HTTP 404 or HTTP 403; the rossetimr.ru materials PDF that had surfaced Makarov education in round 1 returned HTTP 403 this round; www.rosseti.ru and a Bing search fallback returned connection errors or irrelevant localized results. No new biographical fact was found or verified for Kulishov, Makarov, or the three missing degree institution and year values; per the prefer-null-over-an-unverified-guess rule, none of these null fields were filled with a guess, and the round-1 existennaya neopredelennost assessments for Kulishov and Makarov stand unresolved. This negative result is documented per-person in this round-2 pass and in research_notes/FEES/Kulishov_Grigorii_Viktorovich_round_2.md and research_notes/FEES/Makarov_Vladimir_Aleksandrovich_round_2.md. (2) GICS tagging: added company-level sector, industry_group, industry equal to Utilities, Utilities, Electric Utilities, PAO FSK Rosseti is Russia primary high-voltage electricity transmission grid operator, confirmed by the local annual report and financial statements. Tagged every professional_experience entry by the named organization own primary line of business, copied character for character from gics_taxonomy.json: PAO FSK Rosseti, PAO Rossiiskie seti, PAO Rosseti Lenenergo, PAO FSK EES, MES Tsentra, MES Zapadnoi Sibiri, AO OEK and PAO Rosseti equal to Utilities, Utilities, Electric Utilities, all electricity transmission and distribution grid operators within the same group. Set sector, industry_group, industry to null with justification for: government and law-enforcement bodies, Ministerstvo finansov RF, Ministerstvo energetiki RF, Pravitelstvo RF, Generalnaya prokuratura RF, not GICS-classifiable commercial organizations; non-profit industry and professional associations, Assotsiatsiya RNK SIGRE, Soyuz ENERGOSTROI, Assotsiatsiya Tsifrovaya energetika, the same treatment already applied to comparable associations in other processed tickers such as CHMF World Steel Association; and three power-sector R and D, testing and standards subsidiaries, AO FITs, AO NITs EES, AO NTTs FSK EES, whose precise standalone commercial-classification is not independently confirmed by any source found in this project research, so per the do-not-guess-a-GICS-bucket-you-cannot-support rule these three were left null rather than defaulted to Utilities or forced into an unsupported Professional Services guess. (3) qualification_degree: added to every education and degrees entry for all 11 people, using only the ten allowed enum values. Explicit qualifications named in the source were mapped directly, magistr tekhniki i tekhnologii to Master degree, MVA Top-menedzher to MBA, professionalnaya perepodgotovka and professionalnye kvalifikatsii to Professional certification. All kandidat and doktor nauk degrees, one each for Ryumin, Murov, Polinov and Kharitonov, were mapped to Doctoral degree, per the project-wide convention already applied across other tickers, for example ABIO, AFKS, AFLT and AKRN, that these Russian research degrees map to the Doctoral degree enum value. All remaining education entries, phrased in the sources as an okonchil, po spetsialnosti pattern, both pre-2003 and later, were inferred as Specialist degree with high confidence, consistent with the identical project-wide convention already applied to CHMF, AFLT, AKRN, AQUA and CIAN entries phrased the same way; Russian and Soviet 5-year institute and university programs graduating via a named spetsialnost, rather than a bakalavriat or magistratura napravlenie, issued a diplom spetsialista, and several of the relevant fields here, law, legal specialties and pre-1993 to 2004 engineering-economics, were additionally on the government list of professions retained under the single-tier specialist track well after the 2003 Bologna reform. One entry, Novak A. V. 2009 MGU menedzhment second higher education, carries somewhat lower confidence because no source specifies the exact program type for this executive-track second education; it was still tagged Specialist degree on the strength of the explicit specialnost wording rather than left null, and this lower-confidence reasoning is recorded in Novak notes field. (4) University-name normalization: nine raw institution strings in this file, Moskovskii gosudarstvennyi universitet im. M. V. Lomonosova, Gosudarstvennyi universitet grazhdanskoi aviatsii, Moskovskaya gosudarstvennaya yuridicheskaya akademiya, three occurrences, Ivanovskii gosudarstvennyi energeticheskii universitet, Moskovskii energeticheskii institut, Moskovskii gosudarstvennyi stroitelnyi universitet, Rossiiskii universitet druzhby narodov, Rossiiskaya akademiya narodnogo khozyaistva i gosudarstvennoi sluzhby pri Prezidente RF, and Norilskii industrialnyi institut, already had an exact-match canonical entry in university_names.json and were rewritten to their canonical forms; the original raw string is preserved in each entry description field so no information was lost. Four institution strings, Sankt-Peterburgskii gosudarstvennyi universitet, Mezhotraslevoi institut povysheniya kvalifikatsii i perepodgotovki rukovodyashchikh kadrov, Institut problem rynka Rossiiskoi akademii nauk and ANO DPO Institut vnutrennikh auditorov, were already an exact match to their canonical entry, no change needed. No institution not already covered by university_names.json was encountered, so new_institutions_found is empty for FEES this round. (5) Structural check: top-level and per-person key sets are unchanged from the established schema aside from the fields required by this task, company-level sector, industry_group, industry and new_institutions_found; per-professional_experience-entry sector, industry_group, industry; per-education and per-degrees-entry qualification_degree; no key was renamed or removed, and no previously confirmed fact was deleted or overwritten. Self-check performed: every qualification_degree value in this file, Specialist degree, Doctoral degree, Professional certification, Master degree, MBA, is in the ten-value allowed list; every sector, industry_group, industry triple in this file is either an exact row copied from gics_taxonomy.json, Utilities, Utilities, Electric Utilities, or all-null with a justification documented above; every institution string in this file matches an existing canonical entry in university_names.json, confirmed programmatically this round for all thirteen distinct institutions used in this file. || Round 3 (2026-07-19, gap-fill pass): продолжено закрытие пробелов после round 2 для 11 человек.
